remarks: Pristine is what we have at 89 Ward Street. Discover the charm of 89 Ward Street - a stylish home that blends comfort, convenience, and character. Perfectly situated near I-95, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, and dining, this home puts everything right at your fingertips. Step inside to find two cozy bedrooms on the main level and a spacious primary bedroom upstairs, offering the perfect retreat. The attached one-car garage with interior access adds everyday ease, while the covered three-season patio and private yard create the ideal setting for outdoor living. The basement provides laundry and generous storage space. Move-in ready and beautifully maintained, this home is sure to exceed your expectations!
